evidence.text: Should a vulnerability or other issue arise with one of the vaults, then this prevents its removal or replacement, because only one vault per asset is permitted. In the case of the investment ("W-") vaults, that situation is permanent; for the others, we'd have to upgrade at least the vault contract, and possibly the share token contract as well, just to deal with this situation.
Allow an administrator to retire vaults even when balances are zero; if the vault is totally malicious, then any assets have to be considered lost anyway.
The requirement that the vaults have absolutely no assets is too strict, on its own; there are many ways for the asset balance to not be zero:

links.reported_relation: Because only one vault per asset is permitted, a vault with an issue cannot be removed or replaced, while the administrator should be able to retire it even with a nonzero balance.
